transcript: Before you touch your phone in the morning, say these four things to yourself. The last one will shift your entire energy. But first, save this and send it to someone you care about. 1. Gratitude. Thank you for this new morning, for the breath in my lungs and the light that woke me up. Another chance to grow, another chance to love, another chance to try again, even in the small things, there is quiet beauty. 2. Strength. Today, I will meet whatever comes with steady energy. I have strength for what I cannot yet see, patience for people, clarity for decisions, and when I feel weak, I will slow down, not give up. 3. Guidance. May my steps be intentional. May my words be calm. May my reactions be controlled. May my intentions stay clean. Let clarity guide me, not emotion. 4. Surrender. I release what I cannot control. My plans, my worries, my fears. I begin this day with peace in my chest and focus in my mind. Whatever happens, I will walk through it with dignity. Pause. Breathe. Now begin. Follow for more messages like this. Comment, peace, and I'll send you something deeper.
